scope: Phase 6 changed/new text, all docs and samples, README/SECURITY and full current Phase 6 package, including retained rerun logs. Dependency caches, populated env files and frozen previous packages are not republished or scanned as changes.
configuredValueMethod: Exact non-example .env values for credential/password/token/secret keys, minimum length 8; includes independently generated local reproduction secrets.
limitations: Exact-value and obvious-pattern check, not proof against arbitrary encoding, future unknown credentials or universal PII.
